reachable: yes with full browser headers (Akamai); plain curl fails
platform: Adobe AEM with Scene7 dynamic media (dynamicmedia.eaton.com)
catalog_endpoint: https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/skuPage.<SKU>.html (JSON-LD Product with sku; og:image; mdmfiles 1000x1000_300dpi images redirecting to dynamicmedia.eaton.com Scene7). Partial SKU sitemap: https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us.skusitemap.xml (3,722 URLs, none of the samples).
sku_format_match: yes - BR230, BR2125, BRPSURGE, CHN230GF resolve on skuPage URLs with JSON-LD sku equal to the sample
recommended_strategy: GET https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/skuPage.<SKU>.html with full Chrome headers (sec-ch-ua*, Sec-Fetch-*, Upgrade-Insecure-Requests); verify JSON-LD sku; use og:image and the other mdmfiles/<id>/<asset>/1000x1000_300dpi URLs (1000x1000 JPEG via Scene7). 65 SKUs so a slow crawl respecting Crawl-delay 20 is fine. Flag images whose asset name != SKU (e.g. CHN230GF uses CH250GFT_*) as representative.
blockers: Akamai bot protection (needs full browser header set); Crawl-delay 20. Akamai: plain curl gets HTTP/2 INTERNAL_ERROR or 30 s timeouts; it works (HTTP 200) when full Chrome headers are sent (sec-ch-ua, sec-ch-ua-platform, Sec-Fetch-Dest/Mode/Site/User, Upgrade-Insecure-Requests, Accept with image/avif). robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 20. Some SKUs show a representative family image rather than their own (e.g. CHN230GF -> CH250GFT_*, GHB3035 -> GHB3100_*, BAB2040 -> BAB2020_360-*, HMCP150T4C -> HMCP007C0_R).
